auth.login.title: Sign in to {site}
auth.login.lead: Account mode: sign in with your DBLoom account.
auth.login.noMethod: No sign-in method is available. Ask an administrator.
auth.password.mismatch: The two passwords are not the same.
auth.password.policy: At least {count} characters. Not your user name. No other rules.
auth.strength.label: Strength: {level}.
auth.strength.username: Do not include your user name.
auth.mfa.title: Confirm it is you
auth.mfa.lead: Use a second factor to finish signing in.
auth.mfa.codeHint: Six digits. The code changes every 30 seconds.
auth.mfa.recoveryHint: One of your saved codes. Each works once. Dashes and spaces are ignored.
auth.mfa.passkeyLead: Your browser asks you to confirm with your device.
auth.passkey.lead: A passkey lets you confirm with your fingerprint, face, screen lock or a security key.
auth.passkey.name: Passkey name
auth.passkey.nameHint: Helps you tell passkeys apart later.
auth.passkey.unsupported: This browser or device cannot use passkeys.
auth.passkey.cancelled: The passkey prompt was closed. Try again.
auth.passkey.failed: The passkey was not accepted. Try again.
auth.totp.lead: Scan the code with an authenticator app, then enter the six digits it shows.
auth.totp.qrAlt: QR code for your authenticator app
auth.totp.manual: Cannot scan? Enter this key in the app:
auth.codes.title: Save your recovery codes
auth.codes.lead: Each code works once if you lose your second factor. They are shown only now. Keep them somewhere safe, apart from your password.
auth.codes.label: Recovery codes
auth.enrol.title: Add a second factor
auth.enrol.lead: This site requires a second factor. Add one to continue.
auth.change.pageLead: Your password was set by an administrator and must be replaced before you can use DBLoom.
auth.change.title: Change password
auth.change.lead: Other devices are signed out when you change it.
auth.change.leadRequired: Enter the password you were given, then a new one of your own.
auth.invite.title: Create your account
auth.invite.lead: You were invited to DBLoom. Choose a user name and how you sign in.
auth.recover.title: Recover your account
auth.recover.lead: Set a new way to sign in. Your old password, passkeys and codes are removed.
auth.recover.doneLead: Sign in with your new credential. Add a second factor again if your site requires one.
auth.error.auth_failed: Sign-in failed. Check the user name and password.
auth.error.auth_throttled: Too many sign-in attempts. Wait a moment, then try again.
auth.error.mfa_failed: That code or passkey was not accepted. Try again.
auth.error.mfa_expired: The second step took too long or had too many wrong tries. Sign in again.
auth.error.enrol_required: Add a second factor to continue.
auth.error.stepup_required: Confirm it is you to continue.
auth.error.password_rejected: That password is not allowed. Choose a different one.
auth.error.password_rejected.contains_us: The password must not contain your user name.
auth.error.password_rejected.breached: That password appears in a list of leaked passwords. Choose a different one.
auth.error.password_rejected.reused: Choose a password you have not used before.
auth.error.invite_invalid: This invite link is not valid, has expired or was already used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
auth.error.recovery_invalid: This recovery link is not valid, has expired or was already used. Ask an administrator for a new one.
auth.error.vault_locked: The password vault is locked. Unlock it and try again.
auth.error.vault_absent: You have not set up a password vault yet.
auth.error.connection_limit: You have reached the number of open connections.
auth.error.profile_name_taken: You already have a profile with that name.
auth.error.profile_limit: You have reached the number of saved profiles.
auth.error.target_policy: The server policy does not allow this connection.
auth.error.target_policy.root_denied: Signing in as the database user root is not allowed on this server.
auth.error.target_tls: The secure connection to the server failed.
auth.error.target_tls.untrusted_ca: The server certificate is not signed by a trusted certificate authority.
auth.error.target_tls.hostname_mismatch: The server certificate does not match the server name.
auth.error.target_tls.cert_not_yet_valid: The server certificate is not valid yet.
auth.error.target_tls.handshake_failed: The secure connection could not be set up (TLS handshake failed).
auth.error.target_policy.empty_password: Signing in with an empty database password is not allowed on this server.
auth.error.maintenance: DBLoom is in maintenance mode. Try again later.
auth.error.session_ended: Your session has ended. Sign in again.
auth.error.setup_session: The setup session expired. Enter the setup token again.
auth.error.setup_step: That step could not be saved. Check the values and try again.
auth.error.totp_invalid: That code was not accepted. Try again.
